verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the sync server is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hostable Proton Pass server. Offline vault access and E2E encryption are adjacent features, not on-premises hosting, and community comments suggest only the clients are open source.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
